[[File:Megaphone.jpg|thumb|250px|Lumiya uses a loudhailer.]]
A '''loudhailer''', or '''loud-hailer''', was a device used to magnify a person's voice to higher levels so that they could speak to a crowd or project their voice across large distances. It had a pistol grip to better allow users to hold it.

==History==
During the [[Battle of Herdessa (Nagai–Tof War)|Battle of Herdessa]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady]] [[Lumiya]] used a loudhailer to announce to the citizens of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Herdessa/Legends|Herdessa]] that she was going to kill her [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] unless [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was turned over to her.

The [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] used loudhailers to coordinate their operations on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This device is similar to the real-world [[Wikipedia:Megaphone|electronic megaphone]].
